ai.role: Text processing by AI models for the assistant

client.name: User's device
client.role: Browser extension and AkunMu Desktop (AkunMu Desktop data stays on the user's computer)

location.unknown: Not known yet — complete it in platform Settings
location.unknownPublic: location being confirmed by the operator
location.client: The user's own device (not a transfer)

retention.workspace: While the workspace is active, until the user deletes it; deleted permanently when the workspace is deleted in Settings → My data.
retention.findingsOff: Not set: accepted or ignored findings are kept until deleted. Set a findings retention period in Settings → Privacy.
retention.findingsDays: Accepted or ignored findings are deleted automatically {days} days after they were processed.
retention.signInsOff: Active sessions are kept while valid; the history of signed-out sessions is kept until deleted. Set a history retention period in Settings → Privacy.
retention.signInsDays: Active sessions are kept while valid; signed-out sessions are deleted automatically {days} days after sign-out.
retention.auditOff: Not set: audit logs are kept until deleted. Expired attempt counters are deleted automatically every day.
retention.auditDays: Audit logs are deleted automatically after {days} days. Expired attempt counters are deleted automatically every day.
retention.aiOff: Conversations are kept until their owner deletes them.
retention.aiDays: Conversations inactive for {days} days are deleted automatically.
retention.publicUnset: Kept until the user deletes it or you ask for deletion.

transfer.none: No transfer outside Indonesian jurisdiction detected.
transfer.intro: Data is processed at the locations below. Locations outside Indonesia are transfers of personal data outside Indonesian jurisdiction (UU PDP Art. 56; PP 33/2026 Art. 160–174):
transfer.safeguards: Safeguards: data processing agreements with providers, encryption in transit (TLS), limiting the data sent, and the controller's assessment of the destination's level of protection.
transfer.outside: Yes, some data is processed outside Indonesia

processor.scope: On the instructions of {count} workspaces (controllers), {processor} processes data for the activity "{activity}". Each controller sets the purpose and basis of processing; purpose summary: {purpose}
processor.instructions: Processing happens only on the controller's instructions as set out in the Terms of Service (UU PDP Art. 51; PP 33/2026 Art. 139).
processor.subprocessors: Subprocessors engaged for this activity (UU PDP Art. 51(4) and (5)):
processor.security: Per-workspace isolation with row level security, encryption in transit, encrypted integration keys, role-based access and an audit log.
